# DynamicLightsPumpkin

<!-- docs:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by pumpkin-plugins-docs. Edit src/info.ts, then run `pnpm readme`. -->

Server-driven dynamic lights for held items and nearby entities
<!-- docs:end summary -->

## Installation

Put `dynamic-lights-pumpkin.wasm` from the plugin's GitHub release in your server's `plugins/` folder and restart. Hot reload cannot ask for permissions, so the first load needs a restart.

## How it works

Holding a supported light source shows a temporary invisible light block only to your client. It
updates only when you enter another block, change held slot, teleport, respawn, or change world.
Either hand can provide light, and the brighter configured item wins. The server world is never
changed, so no light block can replace terrain or be left behind after a crash.

Built-in sources, including torches and lava buckets, are listed in `config.toml`. Remove an entry to
disable it, change its `light_level`, or add any item ID you want to support.

Entity lights are enabled by default. The plugin checks entities in a 15-block cube around each player every
10 ticks by default and sends changes only when a configured entity light moves, changes level or leaves
range. Configure `entity_sources` with Pumpkin entity names such as `blaze`, `magma-cube`, `glow-squid` or
`glow-squid`. Dropped items use the same configured level as their held form when the plugin observes them
spawn or drop. Existing drops are deliberately not guessed at after a plugin or server restart.

The plugin retains its old recovery data reader solely to repair temporary server light levels written by
an earlier version.

## Permissions

<!-- docs:begin permissions -->
<!-- Generated by pumpkin-plugins-docs. Edit src/info.ts, then run `pnpm readme`. -->

Pumpkin asks for these on the server console the first time the plugin loads.

| Permission | Why |
| --- | --- |
| `fs.read.data` | Read its light-source settings and old recovery data. |
| `fs.write.data` | Write its light-source settings. |
<!-- docs:end permissions -->

## Configuration

<!-- docs:begin config -->
<!-- Generated by pumpkin-plugins-docs. Edit src/info.ts, then run `pnpm readme`. -->

Settings live in `plugins/data/DynamicLightsPumpkin/config.toml`. The plugin creates the file when it is missing and keeps it in step with its settings: new options are added and removed ones dropped, and your values are kept.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sources."<item>".light_level` | integer | none | Light emitted while this item is held, from 0 through 15. |
| `entities.enabled` | boolean | `true` | Whether configured entities emit temporary client-only light. |
| `entities.refresh_interval_ticks` | integer | `10` | Ticks between nearby-entity refreshes. Higher values reduce work but make moving lights less smooth. |
| `entity_sources."<entity type>".light_level` | integer | none | Light emitted by this entity type, from 0 through 15. |

A fresh install gets this file:

```toml
# DynamicLightsPumpkin configuration.
# This file is managed by the plugin: when it starts, settings that were added are written here with
# their defaults and settings that were removed are dropped. Your values are kept; comments you add
# are not.

# Per-item light levels for held sources, including items that are not blocks such as lava buckets.
# Set a level to 0 to disable a source.
#
# [sources."minecraft:lava_bucket"]
# light_level = 15  # Light emitted while this item is held, from 0 through 15.

[sources."minecraft:torch"]
light_level = 14

[sources."minecraft:soul_torch"]
light_level = 10

[sources."minecraft:redstone_torch"]
light_level = 7

[sources."minecraft:lantern"]
light_level = 15

[sources."minecraft:soul_lantern"]
light_level = 10

[sources."minecraft:glowstone"]
light_level = 15

[sources."minecraft:sea_lantern"]
light_level = 15

[sources."minecraft:shroomlight"]
light_level = 15

[sources."minecraft:ochre_froglight"]
light_level = 15

[sources."minecraft:verdant_froglight"]
light_level = 15

[sources."minecraft:pearlescent_froglight"]
light_level = 15

[sources."minecraft:end_rod"]
light_level = 14

[sources."minecraft:jack_o_lantern"]
light_level = 15

[sources."minecraft:magma_block"]
light_level = 3

[sources."minecraft:campfire"]
light_level = 15

[sources."minecraft:soul_campfire"]
light_level = 10

[sources."minecraft:lava_bucket"]
light_level = 15

[sources."minecraft:blaze_rod"]
light_level = 10

[sources."minecraft:blaze_powder"]
light_level = 10

[sources."minecraft:fire_charge"]
light_level = 15

[sources."minecraft:glow_ink_sac"]
light_level = 8

[sources."minecraft:glowstone_dust"]
light_level = 8

[sources."minecraft:magma_cream"]
light_level = 8

# Controls the optional dynamic lights shown around configured entity types.
[entities]

# Whether configured entities emit temporary client-only light.
enabled = true

# Ticks between nearby-entity refreshes. Higher values reduce work but make moving lights less
# smooth.
refresh_interval_ticks = 10

# Per-entity-type light levels. Entity type names use Pumpkin names such as blaze, magma-cube and
# glow-squid.
#
# [entity_sources."blaze"]
# light_level = 15  # Light emitted by this entity type, from 0 through 15.

[entity_sources."blaze"]
light_level = 15

[entity_sources."magma-cube"]
light_level = 8

[entity_sources."glow-squid"]
light_level = 8
```
<!-- docs:end config -->
